title: Topic 1.1: Origin and Consequences of Sin

pages.lesson:
LESSON: ORIGIN AND CONSEQUENCES OF SIN

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: CREATION
Topic 1.1: Origin and Consequences of Sin

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Origin and Consequences of Sin. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is it important to consider the consequences of something before acting?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain the origin of sin from the scriptures provided
2. identify moral values and life skills needed to overcome temptations
3. pray to God to overcome temptations in day-to-day life

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: ORIGIN AND CONSEQUENCES OF SIN
This lesson teaches Origin and Consequences of Sin for Grade 8 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. explain the origin of sin from the scriptures provided
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. identify moral values and life skills needed to overcome temptations
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. pray to God to overcome temptations in day-to-day life
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Origin and Consequences of Sin using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Origin and Consequences of Sin above.
2. Explain Origin and Consequences of Sin to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Origin and Consequences of Sin.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Origin and Consequences of Sin with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Origin and Consequences of Sin important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to consider the consequences of something before acting?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. explain the origin of sin from the scriptures provided
2. identify moral values and life skills needed to overcome temptations
3. pray to God to overcome temptations in day-to-day life

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
